## Key Projects

### Multi-LLM Orchestration Platform
AI workflow platform using multiple LLM providers/models for:
- routing
- scoring
- validation
- fallback handling
- structured outputs
- summarization

Technologies:
- Python
- FastAPI
- PostgreSQL
- AI APIs
- orchestration workflows

### DriveAccessible
Production car rental management platform built using Laravel/PHP.

Features:
- booking workflows
- payment systems
- vehicle availability management
- driver allocation
- reporting dashboards
- backend operational workflows

Focus:
- transactional consistency
- concurrency handling
- preventing double bookings
- backend reliability

### Vault
Real-time file sharing + screen sharing platform.

Features:
- peer-to-peer transfer
- WebRTC communication
- TURN/STUN networking
- real-time chat
- screen sharing

Technologies:
- React
- Node.js
- WebRTC
- WebSockets

### Kanban Pro
Real-time collaborative workspace with:
- live synchronization
- drag-and-drop workflows
- activity tracking
- comments/checklists
- multi-user collaboration

### AI Voice Recruiter Platform
Recruiter workflow platform with AI voice integrations and automation systems.

Features:
- AI voice workflows
- candidate handling
- automation pipelines
- operational tooling
